detail: Full summary: The review's archive recommendation was wrong as written. I proposed replacing the archiver's cutoff=now default with an age-based cutoff; against the #35 loop generating ~400k findings/day that would have exploded the live board. Aggressive archiving was the immune response. Only the count-based form (retain newest K) is safe, which is what the adversarial verifier originally specified.
